import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Set a professional style for the plot
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot of the most discriminative features (petal length vs. petal width)
plt.figure(figsize=(9, 6)) # Set figure size for better readability

    data=df,
    x='petal_length',
    y='petal_width',
    hue='species',
    palette='viridis', # Choose a perceptually uniform color palette
    s=120, # Marker size for better visibility
    alpha=0.8, # Transparency
    edgecolor='w', # White edge for markers
    linewidth=0.5 # Line width for marker edges
)

# Add title and labels for clarity
plt.title('Iris Petal Length vs. Petal Width by Species', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=14)
